name: scatter-chart
title: Scatter chart
description: A scatter plot of x against y, with optional bubble sizes and trendline. Use it to show whether two measures move together and to spot outliers.
author: lokendra-builds <https://github.com/lokendra-builds>
docs:
Scatter chart: https://lokendra-builds.github.io/sheenui/charts/scatter-plot

Installed in components/sheenui/charts/. Import (use your components alias):
import { ScatterChart, ScatterTable } from "@/components/sheenui/charts/scatter-chart";

Next.js: this item takes function props (formatters, seriesLegend(), a dashboard's load), and a Server Component cannot pass functions to a Client Component. Use it from a file that starts with "use client".
